source_selection: All twelve fixed original-publisher ATP/WTA2020-25 captures; six overlaps binary-equal existing publisher cache. No mirror/model/ROI-based source selection.
join: Unique source-name aliases, unordered pair, event name/location signature, round plus draw-size, best-of, surface, 0<=book_day-tournament_start<21; ONLY THEN verify winner and exact set scores. Label/score conflicts quarantine the whole canonical key. No ambiguous last-row/score-based identity rescue.
disputed_input_policy: Before fitting, remove every newly disputed canonical event from targets AND all historical input updates, rebuild features/2020 priors using the original frozen feature algorithm; preserve original cohort/results without rerunning rejected candidates. Accepted price facts remain unchanged and share the new cleaned parent cohort.
quotes: Same-book finite decimal odds>1;1-1e-12<=sum inverse odds<=1.30; no other-book/Max/Avg imputation; exact duplicate observations collapse, different unclocked observations held; all arms same quotes
orientation: unchanged canonical ascending source IDs; source tournament-start dates define the existing five folds; book date used for identity, never a changed split or historical capture clock
estimand: Conditional development comparison given a published historical quote of unknown capture time/type. Tennis features frozen from original delayed tournament-start context. This is NOT an earlier issued forecast, verified PIT or executable return.
availability: training labels require original tournament_start+21d strictly before fold start; source features/priors unchanged; original five folds and2021 expanding fit
devig: existing tennis_wc.betting.devig proportional/power/shin, exact source SHA locked; convergence/swap tested; stop on invalid probability rather than method-specific row drops
inner_selection: one global method per outer fold from the two immediately preceding complete half-years, labels available before outer start; compare match-averaged LL, then Brier, then fixed proportional/power/shin order for ties within1e-12; no ROI selection; need>=600 inner matches
offset: logit(p)=logit(raw proportional fair market p)+beta*x; fixed offset coefficient1, no intercept, ridge1; final probabilities and losses all clipped[.02,.98]. Proportional anchor fixed independently of C02 results; same seven original B_simple signed features, no failed features selected
fit: training-only unique-match std, no mean centering, zero std->1; sum weighted NLL +.5*beta^2; each match total weight1 across books; Newton max100, max step<1e-10; stop FIT_ERROR, no alternative optimizer/grid
tennis_control: same seven features, fit once per unique price-eligible training match; same scaling/penalty; no odds inputs. Report comparison as matched research control, never B_live
C13: training-only ridge encompassing regression with free market-logit coefficient plus same7 tennis columns; report raw-unit coefficients by fold descriptively, no test predictions/p-values/selection from this diagnostic
primary_loss: compute each book loss, average book losses within each canonical match, then mean over matches; NEVER loss at average probability; bootstrap whole matches with all book observations

statistics.p_value: same centered paired bootstrap plus-one two-sided tail as base protocol; carry original raw p-values for original comparisons, absent slots1; no original failed feature reevaluation

development_gate: both LL/Brier nonworsening in all5 folds, pooled both gains>0 and required Holm p<=.05; offset must pass both market and matched tennis controls. Report tour/surface/level/odds/history/coverage and calibration; subgroup regressions remain promotion concerns, not hidden
roi: as-if1u flat policy on shared final-clipped probabilities: EV>0, max one direction/book/match, higher EV, exact ties canonical A. Overall each book weight1/k per match; per-book1u. Completed mutually agreed outcomes only; no exchange/fees/limits/void-return claims. Include drawdown and match-bootstrap ROI CI; hypothetical only, never observed profit/CLV or a promotion gate substitute
stop: missing source/feature/hash/population, any identity ambiguity, method probability failure, mismatched five windows or group weights, synthetic leakage/swap/A-A tests fail -> stop affected phase; no changed cohorts/thresholds to save outcomes
